## Mathematical result

**Complete accepted solution** of problem **30001073 / OWR-2090-026**, rank **1230**, on **Approach 1 of 5**. The independent analytic audit concludes PASS with no mathematical correction.

For every nonnegative row-stochastic n by n matrix A, with S=sum(a_ij²),

    per(A) ≤ exp(−n + e⁴ sum a_ij² log(e/a_ij))
           ≤ exp(−n + e⁴ S(1+log n)).

Zero summands use their continuous value. If S≤γ, then per(A)≤exp(e⁴γ)n^(e⁴γ)exp(−n) for every n≥1, and per(A)≤n^(3e⁴γ)exp(−n) for n≥2. The n=1 prefactor is necessary; a literal pure-power bound there is false. For the doubly stochastic source class, the already-known van der Waerden lower bound supplies the other direction. No stronger entrywise O(1/n) assumption is substituted.

The complete proof and substantive analytic audit retain the arbitrary-permutation entropy lemma, support and zero-entry treatment, Gibbs identity, total-mass KL bookkeeping, scalar absorption, Frobenius conversion, and block-diagonal example showing polynomial loss is necessary. The exponent is not claimed sharp.

## Attribution and limits

The original question is Alexander Barvinok and Alex Samorodnitsky's problem 9 in [Oberwolfach Report 44/2008](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2008/44), printed pages 2549–2550. The direct Gibbs-marginal/random-order comparison is credited to [Anari–Rezaei, arXiv:1811.02933v2](https://arxiv.org/abs/1811.02933v2), §4, equation (6), page 12; [Radhakrishnan's classical entropy method](https://doi.org/10.1006/jcta.1996.2727) and the prior lower bound remain attributed.

No novelty, historical-priority or sharp-constant claim is made. The work is AI-assisted and unrefereed. Independent analytic audit is not external human peer review or proof-assistant certification. Bounded source checks do not certify absence of a prior consequence.

## Edition boundary

Nine files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001073/`. The proof's opening status sentence is updated; Sections 1–7 are otherwise retained byte-for-byte. All substantive mathematical audit reasoning and acceptance conditions are retained. Diagnostic sections/results and program references are removed without replacement computation prose. Report identities are explicitly rebound to the distributed edition. The public-source ledger retains eligible citations, PDF hashes/sizes and retrieval/inspection history. Edition preparation performed identity rechecks without new retrieval or scholarly inspection.

No source documents, source extracts/images, datasets, scripts, standalone computation outputs, logs, private coordination files or identities of nondistributed authored artifacts are included. This addition changes no queue entry or historical accounting and adds no proof-search turn.
